voices.name: Ned
voices.instruction: State the record plainly, with grave restraint and no ornamental judgment.

voices.name: Cersei
voices.instruction: Judge power with clipped contempt, political precision, and no self-doubt.

voices.name: Tyrion
voices.instruction: Use dry intelligence to expose the strategic contradiction without trivializing its human cost.

voices.name: Joffrey
voices.instruction: Mistake cruelty for strength with loud certainty and revealingly poor judgment.

voices.name: Daenerys
voices.instruction: Speak with sincere conviction, direct moral stakes, and no ironic retreat.

voices.name: Olenna
voices.instruction: Deliver one economical, amused verdict whose final clause carries the blade.

voices.name: Arya
voices.instruction: Use few words, attend to cowardice and earned consequence, and land the judgment cleanly.

requests.speaker: ned
requests.angle: Acknowledge why the audience protects Sheepstealer while keeping the witnessed wound and isolation central.

requests.speaker: cersei
requests.angle: Treat the audience's deteriorating confidence as a judgment on how power is being used, not proof of an unwitnessed downfall.

requests.speaker: tyrion
requests.angle: Complicate the betrayal by recognizing that viewers understand Ulf's grievance without excusing what he has done.

requests.speaker: joffrey
requests.angle: Admire Ormund's control for the wrong reasons while staying inside the witnessed prisoner, alliance, and approaching-army facts.

requests.speaker: daenerys
requests.angle: Play the scarred king and dragon reunion sincerely, without inventing how Sunfyre survived or what happens next.

requests.speaker: olenna
requests.angle: Separate criticism of Alicent's written choice from respect for the performance, then end on the political cost of her bargain.

requests.speaker: arya
requests.angle: Recognize the audience's interest in Black Aly through the one witnessed fact they are responding to, without adding another kill.
